Chapter 987: Chapter 5: The Greatest Opportunity of the Origin World (Please Subscribe)_2

…

The atmosphere among the ten strongest beings of human civilization was extremely solemn.

“We owe a great deal to Galaxy. If it weren’t for you, I’m afraid we wouldn’t have known until the very moment the universe was on the brink of destruction.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme took a deep breath and said seriously.

Facing a disaster like the universe’s destruction, knowing in advance versus knowing at the last minute are completely different concepts.

When a normal universe approaches destruction, there would be many signs.

Beings of the Second Layer within the universe would make corresponding preparations.

Such as beginning to migrate populations, gathering up the many resources within the universe, and so on.

But this kind of destruction hastened by external forces, if Lin Yuan hadn’t spoken up, the losses to human civilization would have been immense.

The most critical point is that moving the human population takes time; during the universe’s destruction, the universes within the bodies of the supremes can carry some of the humans by transferring their life essence into the river of time within their universes.

But this process takes time.

Additionally, the universe is vast and contains many resource planets and secret realms.

These planet secret realms could be slowly exploited, functioning like money trees, but if the universe’s destruction is indeed imminent, one would definitely pack everything and leave, even if it means suffering some losses.

“Indeed.”

Xia Qin, along with the other supremes, nodded as well.

If the universe’s destruction can’t be stopped, the best they can do now is to minimize further losses.

…

“If the universe’s destruction really does come, resources and such are not a big issue. They’re inanimate objects and don’t require life essence transfer; they can be placed in any space we open up.”

“But our human… population…”

The Xuanyuan Supreme was somewhat worried – the transfer of life is not as simple as one might imagine.

The universes within the bodies of the nine supremes of human civilization are each hundreds of thousands of light-years in size; combined, they add up to millions of light-years.

Add Lin Yuan’s universe to that.

With so much space, if people were squeezed in a bit and the quality of living environments were reduced somewhat, it would be entirely sufficient to migrate the majority of the human population.

However, during the universe’s destruction, the more lives a supreme carries within their universe, the heavier the cataclysm they would bear.

If a supreme were to carry all life within his universe, including those of the Second Layer, they would endure the full pressure of the Origin Source.

And the Origin Source equates to the life essence of a Chaos Venerable. It’s like facing the full force of a Chaos Venerable, and even the peak of the Path Splitting Realm would be instantly reduced to ashes.

Therefore.

Even if the universe within a supreme is large enough, the number of lives they can take is limited.

According to the current population of human civilization, a supreme could barely take away one in a hundred thousand, and any more would reduce the chances of surviving the cataclysm.

“I can take away one percent of the current human population,” Lin Yuan said after pondering for a while.

“One percent?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme’s pupils contracted. As one of the once twelve pinnacle forces, how vast was the human civilization’s population? Even if it was only one percent, that was still an incredibly large number, trillions upon trillions times trillions.

“Galaxy, ensuring the most complete migration of our human population is critical, but your safety is more important. As long as you’re here, the human civilization will persist…”

Xia Qin said with slight concern.

A supreme at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm would normally be able to safely endure the universe’s destruction, as long as the number of lives they carry doesn’t exceed the limit.

But the current one percent of the human civilization? That is far beyond the limit. At least if a supreme at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm dared to take that many lives, they would face the final targeted destruction from the universe’s Origin Source.

The other supremes looked at Lin Yuan as well. While they naturally hoped that more humans could survive, they did not wish for Lin Yuan to encounter any accidents during the upcoming universe’s destruction.

“Rest assured, I have an idea in mind.”

Lin Yuan nodded; his in-body universe was growing every moment. In hundreds of years, it would reach its limit of eight million light-years in diameter.

With the foundation of such a universe, coupled with Lin Yuan’s many methods, fending off the corresponding level of cataclysm from the universe’s destruction shouldn’t be a problem.

In fact, if Lin Yuan could step into the Dao Realm in the next few hundred years and his in-body universe underwent transformation again, the number of humans he could carry would increase further.

But to ascend from the Path Splitting Realm to the Sovereign Realm… Lin Yuan needs to grow in all aspects to his utmost limit, not just the universe within his body. Lin Yuan has no confidence that he can step into the Sovereign Realm within a thousand years.

This thousand years is a thousand years within the universe, but if it is in the Chaos Void, or that Origin Source, it is merely two or three years.

“That’s good.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme nodded and then turned to the other eight Supremes, “Then let’s leave first and arrange the matters to come.”

“Okay.”

Lin Yuan said.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan felt a sense of urgency.

Even if everything goes well, facing the impending universe destruction, ninety-nine percent of humanity will perish.

Even if Lin Yuan manages to luck into the Sovereign Realm before the imminent universe destruction, he could at most bring along ten times more humans, ninety percent of humanity will still die.

“My strength… is still too weak.”

Lin Yuan sighed. If he were a Chaos Great Saint, the skirmish between the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint couldn’t even shake the region he wished to protect.

The aftershocks of a battle between two Great Saints might force a Chaos Venerable like Ancient Ming to retreat early, but for Great Saints of the same level, it would mean nothing.

If Lin Yuan were to advance further and become the Moyu Tower Master, or a peerless Great Saint like His Majesty Xuanhuang, then no matter how great the enmity of the Shadow Demon Great Saint or the Nine Phoenix Great Saint,

When passing near Lin Yuan’s territory, not to mention fighting, they probably wouldn’t even dare to make a slightly louder noise.

No matter inside the universe or the Chaos Void outside, strength is respected above all.

“Sovereign Realm…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

For nearly all cultivators in the Path Splitting Realm, the most difficult part about ascending to the Sovereign Realm is the comprehension of numerous rules and the corresponding mental will.

However, Lin Yuan has already met all these requirements; for Lin Yuan, ascending to the Sovereign Realm is merely a matter of time. He only needs all aspects of his physical body, Soul Body, and the universe within to naturally reach their peak, then he can ascend.

…

Origin Source, Qingfen Domain, Yu Family.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

“The injuries have almost all recovered.”

Lin Yuan examined his internals and saw that the injuries caused by the unique dark energy erosion from the Dongyang Family had now healed by ninety percent.

“The cultivation system of this Origin Source…”

Many pieces of information emerged in Lin Yuan’s mind, the most important being that including the Yu Family, Dongyang Family, and even the Lord Qingfen, their cultivation paths all originated from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country, a colossal entity that the original Yu Yan had been hearing about since he was a child, is said to have an ancestor who was the eternal Fierce Sun above the firmament.

“Eternal Fierce Sun?”

Lin Yuan looked up slightly, and even though separated by an unknown amount of space and time, he could still feel the terror of the Fierce Sun above the sky, at least far surpassing the feeling the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming gave him.

“If this eternal Fierce Sun truly transformed into the ancestor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, then what realm is he? A Chaos Great Saint? A peerless Great Saint? Or a Thirteenth Layer temporal life form?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even compared to the images left by Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master, that eternal Fierce Sun seemed far more powerful.

Of course, the eternal Fierce Sun Lin Yuan felt was just an insignificant part of its full power, as were the images of Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master.

The two could not be directly compared.

“Forget it.”

“Thinking about these matters now is too far-fetched.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts and began to look at the space-time around him, his expression revealing a trace of excitement, “The space-time of this Origin Source is displaying directions entirely different from those of the Main Universe and the Chaos Void.”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the minutiae of space-time, while comparing them to those of the Main Universe and the Chaos Void.

Hum! Hum! Hum!!

Countless sparks of enlightenment surged in Lin Yuan’s mind, feeling his understanding of space-time advancing in a terrifying manner.
